build_rl_world_with_ppo_agent: build a PyBullet RL world with a PPO agent loaded from a JSON config file
update_world_step_and_reward: update the RL world by one timestep and calculate the agent reward
build_arg_parser_from_file: build an argument parser that loads configuration from a specified args file or directory
run_multiclip_rl_simulation: run a multi-clip DeepMimic RL simulation with keyboard controls for animating and stepping
